name: Sandrone / Mizuki + Fischl + Kaeya (Stellar Swirl)

fields: Sandrone, Fischl, Kaeya, Mizuki kits: frames, mechanics

assumptions: No published rotation for this exact team: the rotation is ours. Mizuki, Fischl and Kaeya (all support/off-field here) cast their skill and burst first, then Sandrone (on-field) casts skill and burst and autoattacks until the rotation ends (length = Fischl's 25.3s skill cooldown, matching the sister team sandrone-stellar-conduct-kaeya).

Fischl's Electro application lets Sandrone's own Cryo hits (and Kaeya's) trigger real Stellar-Conduct (Polestar Field: team Cryo/Electro DMG%, −40% enemy physical RES); Mizuki's Anemo hits then Stellar-Swirl the Cryo aura, boosted by both her own EM-scaled Skill passive and Sandrone's ATK-scaled Stellar Jubilee (kb/characters/sandrone.json, mizuki.json).

Sandrone is partly baseline: no gcsim source exists for her (frames estimated; Fagio/Decoding Power, the separate Radiance: Stellar Swirl upgraded hit forms, and her constellations are not modelled — only her Stellar-Conduct/Stellar-Swirl passive and its ATK-scaled reaction bonus are). Mizuki's C1 (enemy-status-gated bonus swirl damage) and C6's crit grant to other characters' Swirls are also not modelled — see kb/characters/yumemizuki-mizuki.json.
Weapons default to the highest base ATK weapon of each type in the KB (no recommendation in the KB); no artifact set bonuses.
notes: Stellar Swirl team: Mizuki's Anemo hits Swirl Sandrone's (or Kaeya's) Cryo aura into Stellar Swirl because Sandrone's Stellar Jubilee passive is in the team; Fischl's Electro also lets Superconduct become Stellar-Conduct for the Polestar Field's team buff. Mizuki cast early (before Fischl/Kaeya apply Electro/Cryo) so her Dreamdrifter window and its team-wide Swirl/Stellar-Swirl DMG bonus are already up when the reactions start landing.
